changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'LoadItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[LoadItem]( [LoadID] [int] NOT NULL, [RowIndex] [int] NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [Status] [bit] NULL, [StatusMessage] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [KeyHash] [varchar](250) NULL, [FieldHash] [varchar](250) NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [ParentAssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_LoadItem] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [LoadID] ASC, [RowIndex] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_LoadItem_Load') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[LoadItem] WITH NOCHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_LoadItem_Load] FOREIGN KEY([LoadID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Load] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[LoadItem] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_LoadItem_Load] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_LoadItem_Load') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_LoadItem_Load] ON [dbo].[LoadItem] ( [LoadID] DESC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[LoadItem]') AND name = 'IntersectUid' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].LoadItem ADD IntersectUid uniqueidentifier END
